name: Patch and rebuild the Ghidra decompiler
description: Applies a patch to the decompiler C++ source shipped inside an existing Ghidra install and rebuilds the native binaries, so Ghidra runs the patched decompiler. Layer it on top of a prebuilt Ghidra image (e.g. ghcr.io/clearbluejar/ghidra-python). Bundles the diff-stable default variable name patch (NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra#10025).

patch.description: Bundled patch to apply. 'none' applies only patch_url.

patch_url.description: URL of an additional unified diff (git format-patch, -p1 relative to the Ghidra install dir) applied after the bundled patch.

ghidra_install_dir.description: Ghidra install directory. Defaults to $GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR from the image, then /ghidra.
